questions.question: A class has @RequestMapping("/api/classes") and one of its methods has @RequestMapping("/summary"). What is the full address of that method?
questions.explanation: The class-level path is a prefix, and the method path is joined to it, giving /api/classes/summary.

questions.question: A method is annotated with @RequestMapping("/items") and no method attribute. Which HTTP methods does it match?
questions.explanation: Without the method attribute the mapping matches every HTTP method, so it is safer to set it or use @GetMapping.

questions.question: A method is mapped with path /book, method POST and consumes = "application/json". A client sends POST /book with Content-Type text/plain. What status does it get?
questions.explanation: The path and HTTP method match, but the content type does not, so Spring answers 415 Unsupported Media Type.

questions.question: Only GET /api/classes is mapped. A client sends DELETE /api/classes. What status does it get?
questions.explanation: The path exists but no method handles DELETE, so Spring answers 405 Method Not Allowed.

questions.question: Two methods in one controller are both @RequestMapping(path = "/menu", method = RequestMethod.GET) with no other conditions. What happens?
options: The app fails to start with an ambiguous mapping error
Spring runs both methods and merges the results
The second method is ignored silently
questions.explanation: Spring cannot choose between two identical mappings, so startup fails with an Ambiguous mapping error.
